newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peace group seeks cease-fire.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peace group seeks cease-fire.

text.p: A regional peace commission called Thursday on a right-wing paramilitary group in northwest Colombia to call a month's ceasefire as a prelude to possible peace talks.
The commission, based in Antioquia province and made up of prominent local businessmen and political personalities, said it was looking to open negotiations with all armed groups.

The national Peace and Conciliation Commission, made up of Church and political representatives, has been talking about the possibility of starting negotiations to end Colombia's three decade old guerrilla war but there has been little firm progress.
